Convex Relaxations of Scheduling Problems
Petr Novak

Abstract
We study convex relaxations.

1 Introduction
Scheduling problems are hard. Linear programming relaxations give lower bounds on the optimal makespan,
and we strengthen them with semidefinite constraints that capture pairwise precedence information.

2 Semidefinite Relaxations
The semidefinite relaxation lifts the assignment variables into a matrix and adds precedence cuts.
It is solved with an interior point method in polynomial time for moderate instance sizes.

3 Experiments
On standard benchmarks the gap closes by thirty percent compared to the linear relaxation baseline.
